0022600176.text: The Nets (1-6, 15th in the East and 5.5 games back for fifth in the Atlantic) host the Hornets (3-5, 9th in the East and 1.5 games back for third in the Southeast) in Brooklyn, with Brooklyn at 0-3 at home and Charlotte on a four-game losing streak. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring). Charlotte won the last meeting 110-103 in Brooklyn on October 21, and the Nets trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season so far after losing 1-2 in 2025-26.
